slug.description: URL slug of the calendar, unique per owner. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

dayCount.description: Number of days. Day N falls on startDate + (N - 1) days.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone that day boundaries follow. Defaults to Asia/Tokyo.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the calendar was created.

startDate.description: Calendar date of day 1 in the calendar's time zone, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the calendar was last updated.

slotsPerDay.description: How many participants can take the same day. Defaults to 1.

allowExternal.description: Whether entries may point to posts outside site.mochott.article (site.standard.document records or plain URLs).

excludedEntries.description: site.mochott.adventEntry record URIs the owner removed from the calendar. The entries stay in their authors' repos but are not shown and do not hold a day.

maxDaysPerPerson.description: How many days one participant other than the owner can take. Absent means no limit.

main.description: Record describing an advent calendar owned by the account. Participants claim days with site.mochott.adventEntry records in their own repos.

description: An advent calendar: a run of consecutive days on which participants each publish one post.
